    "Model forecasts undershoot current prices when prices are declining rapidly",

    "When sentiment is negative (-0.33), model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes",
    "Lag effect: model forecasts trail behind price momentum, especially in upticks",
    "Forecasts flatten out too quickly from initial price levels, missing true price volatility",
    "Sentiment zero or unclear (0.00) regions show highest forecast-error variance"
] }
